extracted_concepts.name: 偏微分方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 含未知函数偏导数的方程

extracted_concepts.name: 波动方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∂²u/∂t² = c²∂²u/∂x²，描述弦振动、声波、电磁波

extracted_concepts.name: 热传导方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∂u/∂t = k∂²u/∂x²，描述温度分布、扩散过程

extracted_concepts.name: 拉普拉斯方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∂²u/∂x² + ∂²u/∂y² = 0，描述稳态温度、电势、流速势

extracted_concepts.name: 调和函数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 满足拉普拉斯方程的函数

extracted_concepts.name: 达朗贝尔解
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 波动方程的解 u(x,t)=f(x-ct)+g(x+ct)

extracted_concepts.name: 光滑化效应
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 热传导方程解在 t>0 时立即变光滑

extracted_concepts.name: 分离变量法
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 假设 u(x,t)=X(x)·T(t)，代入 PDE 后分离变量

extracted_concepts.name: 分离变量假设
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u(x,t)=X(x)T(t)

extracted_concepts.name: 初边值问题
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 波动方程带有边界条件和初始条件的问题

extracted_concepts.name: 特征值问题
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: X'' + λX = 0, T'' + c²λT = 0

extracted_concepts.name: 特征函数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: X_n(x)=sin(nπx/L)

extracted_concepts.name: 特征值
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: λ_n=(nπ/L)²

extracted_concepts.name: 级数解
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u(x,t)=Σ Bₙ sin(nπx/L) cos(nπct/L)

extracted_concepts.name: 傅里叶级数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f(x)=a₀/2 + Σ[aₙcos(nπx/L)+bₙsin(nπx/L)]

extracted_concepts.name: 傅里叶系数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: aₙ=(1/L)∫f(x)cos(nπx/L)dx, bₙ=(1/L)∫f(x)sin(nπx/L)dx

extracted_concepts.name: Parseval 等式
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: (1/L)∫|f(x)|²dx = a₀²/2 + Σ(aₙ² + bₙ²)

extracted_concepts.name: Dirichlet 条件
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 分段光滑函数的傅里叶级数收敛条件

extracted_concepts.name: 收敛性
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 分段光滑函数的傅里叶级数收敛
